description: Start an upgrade of the signed-in person's GolfCore API account to basic ($10 a month for 10,000 requests, then $2.00 per 1,000 up to a monthly budget) or business ($50 a month for 100,000, then $1.00 per 1,000). Returns a Stripe checkout URL for the person to review and pay; this tool does not charge them. If the account already has a paid plan it returns the billing page, where the person switches plans themselves. Ask which plan they want first.
name: api_upgrade
title: Upgrade a GolfCore API plan
